verdict.rationale: Clerk's own materials claim built-in, ML-based bot detection and multi-account protection that blocks fraudulent sign-ups in real time, plus brute-force prevention on email/SMS one-time passcodes and disposable-email blocking. That covers the bot and part of the brute-force portions of the story. These are marketing-level claims, though, and nothing addresses credential stuffing or password brute force (lockout or rate limiting on password sign-in). Missing for 10: credential-stuffing protection, password-attempt lockout/rate-limit documentation, in-depth configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
